output.title: Applies only if cert-manager runs with --namespace; not visible here
output.content: I can't tell whether this change applies, because the environment summary doesn't show whether cert-manager runs with `--namespace=<namespace>`. Per ev-ef5237d47ade, the fix only changes behaviour in that mode: it limits cert-manager to a single namespace and turns off cluster-scoped controllers. None of the four values keys you set (global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled, prometheus.servicemonitor.targetPort, replicaCount) passes that flag, but the summary doesn't include the container args of your apps/v1 Deployment. Check the cert-manager controller Deployment's args for `--namespace`; if it's there, confirm that your setup still works once cluster-scoped controllers are disabled.
